description: This file 'TraceControl.h' declares macros and includes essential headers for tracing and logging within the Thunder project's messaging system. It defines controls for tracing behavior and hooks into various logging mechanisms, including duration-based tracing.

methods.name: TRACE_CONTROL
methods.description: Macro to instantiate a control object for a given category that manages whether tracing is enabled.

methods.name: TRACE_ENABLED
methods.description: Macro to check if tracing is enabled for a given category.

methods.name: TRACE
methods.description: Macro to perform tracing/logging if enabled for a specific category, capturing message data, timing, and context.

methods.name: TRACE_GLOBAL
methods.description: Macro similar to TRACE but with global scope, capturing broader context information.

methods.name: TRACE_DURATION
methods.description: Macro to measure execution duration of a code block and log it.

methods.name: TRACE_DURATION_GLOBAL
methods.description: Macro to measure execution duration globally and log it.
